goal: Operate the integrated AI-native media business as one evidence-coupled system across audience growth, original digital IP usage, commercialization and production economics; turn independent workstreams into explicit owner decisions without blocking unrelated work.
audience: Technology, business and internet-culture viewers; the internal decision audience is the owner/showrunner and the team responsible for production, growth, IP usage and commercialization.

MEDIA_GROWTH.goal: Audience, topic portfolio, platform-native packaging, retention and qualified growth.
hard_constraints: Views alone do not decide portfolio allocation.
Each platform derivative must be re-authored for platform behavior.
News and fiction remain clearly separated.

ORIGINAL_DIGITAL_IP.goal: Use approved original IP as a reusable recognition and business asset.
hard_constraints: IPOS is the sole identity-canon authority.
Video imports only an owner-approved READY_FOR_VIDEO bundle with exact versions and rights.
Performance feedback may propose learning but cannot mutate canon.
Do not force a character into every topic or shot.

COMMERCIALIZATION.goal: Develop advertiser mapping, offers, rights packages, sponsor integration and commercial measurement.
hard_constraints: Commercial fit cannot rewrite editorial or product truth.
No sponsor is required for content worthiness.
Impressions/views alone do not prove sponsor effectiveness.

PRODUCTION_SYSTEM.goal: Produce truthful, distinctive, technically sound, reusable media at measured cost.
hard_constraints: Choose the best admissible medium per shot; do not maximize AI-video percentage.
Candidate generation is not acceptance or promotion.
Rights, continuity, human craft review and technical release gates are fail-closed.

cross_workstream_invariants: Audience evidence informs portfolio and packaging.
IP performance informs future hypotheses but IPOS alone controls canon.
Commercial obligations may change deliverables and rights but never editorial conclusions.
Production cost, retry, accepted-take and reuse evidence feed portfolio allocation.
No single metric is the global objective.
All cross-workstream influence is an explicit evidence artifact and decision receipt.
Independent workstreams run in parallel; only true causal dependencies block tasks.
No automatic publication, paid provider operation or external spend.
hard_constraints: Do not recreate or mutate IPOS identity canon.
Do not claim the supplied Jensen/Alice media has been inspected until the exact source bytes and digest are available.
Do not treat unverified allegations as established fact.
Do not release the Jensen case until rights, human cold-read, platform format/disclosure, editorial plan, master timeline and red-team evidence pass.
Keep historical 0.8 modules as optional verified capabilities, not as a second controller.
preferences: Reuse proven local/open-source capabilities where they meet the quality bar.
Parallelize independent work and keep evidence handoffs explicit.
unknowns: Owner-approved IPOS READY_FOR_VIDEO bundle is not available in the current snapshot.
The exact Jensen/Alice source video must be imported and inspected.
Current performance and commercial outcome receipts are not yet present in the standalone project.
success_criteria: All four workstreams have durable evidence and explicit dependencies.
Independent research and candidate work proceeds while IPOS or media-specific tasks wait.
Owner adjudication consumes all competing candidates and emits a durable decision.
The Jensen case remains candidate-only until every required media, rights, editorial, platform and human gate passes.
Production and business decisions use measured outcomes, counterevidence and explicit trade-offs.
